items.reason: No content lost. Two small drifts from the source: "a great many Whales" is lowercased (the brief says a rendered paragraph follows the source's capitalization), and "beating the sea before him" becomes "ahead of it", which drops the masculine personification that the other extracts keep ("his mouth" in extracts.33, "his head" in extracts.30). Minimal fix: restore "Whales" and "him" and, for agreement, use "This one came" (the source says "This came").
items.new: "We had hardly been two days at sea when, about sunrise, a great many Whales and other sea monsters appeared. Among the former, one was of a most monstrous size.... This one came toward us open-mouthed, raising the waves on every side and beating the sea ahead of him into foam." — Tooke's Lucian. "The True History."
